title: Layne's Revel Product Mix
description: Credentials and report settings for the Layne's Revel Product Mix report.

url.title: Revel Product Mix URL
url.description: URL of the Revel Product Mix report.

username.title: Revel username
username.description: Username used to sign into Revel.

password.title: Revel password
password.description: Password used to sign into Revel.

establishment.title: Revel establishment
establishment.description: Establishment to select after login. The current Actor version supports Leander only.

override_flag.title: Override date
override_flag.description: When enabled, the Actor reports on override_date. When disabled, it reports on yesterday in US Central Time. The report always covers 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM of that single date.

override_date.title: Override report date
override_date.description: Report date in MM/DD/YYYY format, used as both the start and end date. Used only when override_flag is true.
